checks: Literal IPv4 127.0.0.1 bind only; serial HTTPServer and unique server-assigned safe native request IDs.
Request line and headers share absolute five-second deadline and 65536-byte cap; slow-byte dribble regression refuses then intake recovers.
POST requires one exact Content-Length <=524288, one JSON content type, one safe session; transfer encodings, Expect and duplicate framing refuse before service.
Body uses separate absolute five-second deadline and bounded incremental reads; incomplete body and timeout refuse.
Strict UTF-8 JSON rejects duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers and excessive nesting.
Only fixed health/models/completion routes; HTTP0.9 and unsupported methods refuse; every response closes the connection.
Draining/halted service prevents new requests; runtime/serialization failure halts listener intake without retry or owner lifecycle action.
Recoverable ChatRequestError returns generic400 unless service has already halted, when generic503 takes precedence.
Disconnect during normal completion preserves normal disposition; socket write failures do not cancel or restart owner.
Errors do not expose exception details, request contents or private filesystem paths.
resolved_findings: Inherited request-line/header parser originally had only idle timeout; agent added absolute bounded header reader and dribble/size/HTTP0.9 regression coverage.
scope: Actual ephemeral loopback sockets against synthetic service only; no native executable, model process, GPU, real checkpoint operations or deployed service used.
Caller must supply an independently admitted ChatService; make_server does not establish model/tokenizer/runtime identity.
Local unauthenticated experiment; sessions share coordinator checkpoint root. No remote serving, streaming, cancellation or full OpenAI compatibility claim.
